_comment: M0, the cold-open bed (3 bars = 6.000 s = 180 f): a bar-line edit of one Eleven Music take (music_v2_5, seed 909, 20 s, 119.992 BPM, beats at 0.004 + k/2 s). Raw take: sparse sub pulse with ticks 0-6.5 s, sub drop-out 6.75-7.5, the build with glitch stabs from 8, a 0.25 s stop at 15.0, the peak 16-20 (no fade). Bar 1 is the sparse pulse; bars 2-3 the build and the peak; a synthesized riser climbs over the last 2.5 s and is cut dead with everything by the hard stop (6 ms ramp) on the bar line at 6.000 s.

segments.why: bar 1: the sparse sub pulse and ticks
bar 2: source bar 6, the build (stabs on 1 and the and of 2)
bar 3: source bar 10, the peak; hard stop at 6.0

synth.why: the riser, at its top on the hard stop
